title: Screaming Toast Simulator
description: A photorealistic interactive toaster. Push the lever down to toast bread; the longer you hold it, the higher and more operatic the bread's synthesized scream becomes until it launches into orbit.

title: Passive-Aggressive Cursor
description: A minimalist luxury button that you have to click, except your cursor has an independent unionized personality, sighs audibly via Web Audio, takes coffee breaks, and criticizes your mouse movement speed.

title: Gravity Noodles
description: A fullscreen neon bowl of elastic Verlet-physics noodles that slither around your cursor, slurp with synthesized wet sound effects when flicked, and tie themselves into hypnotic glowing knots.

title: Bureaucratic Cookie Banner
description: A website that is 100% GDPR cookie preferences. Unchecking Existential Tracking spawns 14 sub-toggles, a marble balancing beam, and a notary stamp.

title: Frog Choir Conductor
description: Conduct a seven-voice polyphonic amphibian choir on a moonlit pond. Realistic Web Audio ribbit formants, pupil-tracking eyes, inflatable vocal sacs, and majestic choral harmonies.

title: Infinite Bubble Wrap Deluxe
description: Endless procedural bubble wrap with 5 tactile modes (Classic Plastic, Crunchy Glass, Orchestral Timpani, Laser Pew, and Golden Giant Bubble). Supports 120fps drag-popping, procedural Web Audio synthesis, and infinite scrolling.

title: Cosmic Lava Lamp Shader
description: A mesmerizing WebGL raymarched metaball lava lamp floating in deep space. Drag to stir the molten neon blobs, scroll to shift gravitational pull, and listen to an evolving ambient drone that reacts to blob collisions.

title: Excuse Generator 3000
description: A retro slot-machine terminal that spins three mechanical reels (Technical Jargon, Blame Target, Confidence Multiplier) to generate bulletproof excuses for why your ticket isn't done yet, complete with mechanical clunks, suspicion meter, and dot-matrix receipt printouts.
